# Charts

This layer contains various chart rendering and parsing utilities for the Excalidraw project, including functions for rendering bar, line, radar, and Cartesian charts, as well as parsing spreadsheet data into chart elements.

## Overview

This layer focuses on creating and parsing charts within the Excalidraw application. It provides the necessary tools to render different types of charts and parse data from spreadsheets to be used in these charts.

## Responsibilities

- **Rendering Charts**: Functions to render bar, line, radar, and Cartesian charts.
- **Parsing Data**: Functions to parse spreadsheet data into chart elements.

## How it works

- **charts.bar.ts**: Exports functions to render bar charts. (`renderBarChart`)
- **charts.constants.ts**: Defines constants for chart dimensions and layout. (`CARTESIAN_BASE_SLOT_WIDTH`, `CARTESIAN_BAR_SLOT_EXTRA_PER_SERIES`, `CARTESIAN_BAR_SLOT_EXTRA_MAX`)
- **charts.helpers.ts**: Provides helper functions for chart rendering and parsing. (`isSpreadsheetValidForChartType`, `getCartesianChartLayout`, `getChartDimensions`)
- **charts.line.ts**: Exports functions to render line charts. (`renderLineChart`)
- **charts.parse.ts**: Exports functions to parse spreadsheet data. (`tryParseNumber`, `tryParseCells`, `tryParseSpreadsheet`)
- **charts.radar.ts**: Exports functions to render radar charts. (`renderRadarChart`)
- **charts.types.ts**: Defines types for chart elements and spreadsheet data. (`ChartElements`, `Spreadsheet`, `SpreadsheetSeries`)
- **index.ts**: Exports all chart-related functions and types. (`ParseSpreadsheetResult`, `Spreadsheet`, `SpreadsheetSeries`)

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `packages/excalidraw/tsconfig.json`.
